text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our second summer camp starts<n>today! Shinko
Windy has found<n>herself to be the center of
attention.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Would you like some candy, Windy?<n>Look, I've got
extra-chewy gummies!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: If you're offerin', then I'm takin'!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I brought something for you too! Do<n>you want any
juice? You went all out<n>at the Teio Sho, didn't you?
What<n>was it like?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The Teio Sho? Sure, I'll tell you. After<n>all, that race is
gonna go down in<n>history!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gotta say though... I sure am popular<n>today, aren't
I? Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Of course you are! You've been doing<n>so well in
your recent races, it's only<n>natural everyone would
fawn over<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Really? People are fawning over me?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And now it's my turn! You're the<n>best, Windy!
Have some Carrot<n>Ranger chips!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh-hooo? So this is "fawning," eh?! I<n>could get used
to this!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, what fun. Perhaps I'll try my<n>hand, too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait! Too much and it's bound<n>to go to
Windy's head—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Or... maybe not. She isn't like she<n>used to be
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If this were back then, I'd have<n>reason to worry,
but... hardly anyone<n>talks about her old incident
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I hope that everyone around the<n>world can see
Windy for who she<n>really is now.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Totally... I know the kind of damage a<n>nasty scandal
can do. I've seen it far<n>too many times...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whether you're a racer or an Umadol,<n>it's not easy
to change your image<n>once it's been set in place.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But it isn't impossible—Windy is proof<n>of that.
Popular opinion is shifting,<n>slowly but surely.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep! The past naturally drifts away<n>once we've
obtained something new.<n>Redirect the flow of qi,
and your fate<n>changes in turn!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
With the luck and good qi Windy's<n>accumulating,
she'll definitely shine<n>real soon!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Good grief. Getting fawned<n>over's real
exhausting!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But I'm super psyched for all the<n>training,
fireworks, and watermelon<n>smashing that's in
store!
choice_data_list: Let's make the best of our summer camp!
Let's make the best of our summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! Just watch... by the end of<n>this summer,
I'mma turn into<n>Ultimate☆Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Those few meatheads who still doubt<n>my skill are
in for a wake-up call!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy is fired up to get<n>stronger, and our
scorching summer<n>is set to begin!
